fact: Semlex says Guinea-Bissau has 18 production centres for biometric national ID cards nationwide, the newest at Safim opened 30 January 2026 with capacity of 100 cards a day.

fact: Biometric Update reports Guinea-Bissau already has a functional biometric national ID card system, being modernised under a Swiss-financed UNDP 'Building National ID' project, and has fully operationalised the ECOWAS ENBIC biometric ID card.

fact: Semlex says its subsidiary opened a third biometric ID enrolment centre in Cacheu region (Sao Domingos) on 26 February 2026, with more planned at Bolama and Bula.
Smile ID says the national ID card, issued by the National Police Directorate under the Ministry of Security and Civil Protection, is the primary KYC document in Guinea-Bissau.

UNDP and the Swiss Confederation support a project to build a national identification system in Guinea-Bissau, digitising the civil registry books as the main national platform, with the Ministry of Justice and Human Rights as beneficiary.
